basic_1.level_1: Which command did you learn in the tutorial to show things on screen? 📺
basic_1.level_2: The command starts with "pr" and ends with "int()". Like printing on screen!
basic_1.level_3: The answer is print()! We use print("text") to show anything on screen.

basic_3.level_1: Which command shows text on screen? 🖥️
basic_3.level_2: The command is print(). Just type print before the parenthesis.
basic_3.level_3: Complete with: print. The code becomes: print("Olá, mundo!")

var_2.level_1: To create a variable, you just need to choose a name! 📦
var_2.level_2: The variable name must be "idade". Write: idade = 10
var_2.level_3: The answer is: idade. The code becomes: idade = 10

dec_3.level_2: The word is "if". if idade >= 18: checks if age is 18 or older.
dec_3.level_3: Complete with: if. The code becomes: if idade >= 18:

loop_3.level_1: Remember: range does not include the stop number! 🔢
